import openpyxl, os
out=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
ws=wb['Sheet2']
for r in range(2,6):
    ws.cell(row=r,column=9).value=f'=INDEX(A2:E25,MATCH($I$1,B2:B25,0),MATCH(H{r},A1:E1,0))'
wb.save(out)
print('done')
